sources.title: [2402.09668] How to Train Data-Efficient LLMs - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The training of large language models (LLMs) is expensive. In this paper, we study data-efficient approaches for pre-training LLMs, i.e., techniques that aim to optimize the Pareto frontier of model quality and training resource/data consumption.
